positioning.title: Industry knowledge, data, and models — turned into business agents that live inside workflows
positioning.description: Vxture is a platform company for industry LLMs and business agents. We do not sell generic models, and we do not stop at tools: a platform-level foundation carries the agents, industry scenarios package them by the way work is actually done, and the Ruyin workbench puts them in the hands of every role.

items.title: Two dimensions: general × industry
items.description: General agents work out of the box — proposal writing, business analysis, contract review, digital legal. Industry agents are packaged by how the work is done — low-altitude, emergency, energy and power, industrial. One catalog, pick by scenario, no platform build-out first.

items.title: Two layers: agents × platform
items.description: Agents grow on a platform-level foundation: intelligent data governance (ARDA), enterprise knowledge service (KARDA), with model access and capability orchestration provided as infrastructure. Each layer works alone and stacks upward.

items.title: One entry: the Ruyin workbench
items.description: A desktop workbench that brings agents, data, and daily work into one place where individuals and teams collaborate — everything above is ultimately used from here.

method.title: Standard capabilities by subscription, industry scenarios by co-creation
method.description: Two paths, one foundation. Standard capabilities are subscribed: see pricing on the site, order in the console, use on activation, with quota by tier and top-up packs when needed. Industry scenarios are co-created: start from one clear pain point, build a small verifiable loop, then expand to more roles. The four steps are sequential — each takes the previous step's output as input.

steps.title: Pick one scenario
steps.description: Choose the closest agent or scenario from the catalog or an industry solution, and define its responsibility boundary first — not the model.

steps.title: Connect data and knowledge
steps.description: Govern data definitions and quality with ARDA; turn documents, policies, and cases into searchable, reasonable knowledge with KARDA — trusted context for the agent.

steps.title: Orchestrate the agent
steps.description: On the foundation, combine models, retrieval, rules, business tools, and human confirmation so the agent completes tasks instead of only answering.

steps.title: Launch and operate
steps.description: After a pilot and evaluation, enter the real workflow; watch usage, quota, and billing in the console, upgrade the tier or add packs as needed, and iterate on feedback.

principles: No over-promising: validate real value first, then expand scope.
Stay inside customer systems: bring agents into existing workflows rather than building another one.
Deliver more than pages: data, knowledge, permissions, and operations ship together.

capabilities.title: A four-layer product system — each layer delivered on its own
capabilities.description: From out-of-the-box agents, to scenarios packaged by industry, to the platform foundation that carries them — subscribe to one, or land the whole set. Three delivery modes: online subscription, private deployment, close co-creation.

items.title: General agents · Digital employees
items.description: Proposal writing, business analysis, contract review, digital legal — for pre-sales, management, legal, and administrative roles; subscribe on sign-in, pick by scenario.

items.title: Industry agents · Business-critical
items.description: Low-altitude dispatch and drone monitoring, emergency command, industrial equipment inspection, supply chain collaboration, urban risk assessment, data governance, battlefield simulation — packaged by how each industry works.

items.title: Platform products · Foundation
items.description: Intelligent Data Governance Platform ARDA, Enterprise Knowledge Service Platform KARDA, Enterprise Password Service Platform UMBRA; model access and capability orchestration provided as infrastructure.

items.title: Industry solutions · Full-set delivery
items.description: Packaged scenarios for low-altitude economy, emergency management, energy and power, and industrial operations, backed by deployed case studies — usable on delivery.

cta.title: Start co-creation from one business pain point
cta.description: Pick one scenario — contract review, business analysis, emergency command, data governance, or one from your industry — and build the first usable, measurable, iterative business agent.
